name: cadherin EGF LAG seven-pass G-type receptor 1

function.text: CELSR1 is the approved symbol for cadherin EGF LAG seven-pass G-type receptor 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in calcium ion binding; G protein-coupled receptor activity; apical protein localization.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Glioblastoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CELSR1 encodes cadherin EGF LAG seven-pass G-type receptor 1. Its functions include calcium ion binding and G protein-coupled receptor activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CELSR1 have been reported in glioblastoma, ovarian carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
